_comment: MM2_classic.json — KDF Reloaded compatibility template. Use this as a starting point when migrating from a GLEEC KDF (or upstream Komodo DeFi Framework) deployment. Every entry under `compatibility` pins a switch to the value that reproduces the original behaviour. Remove individual entries to opt into the corresponding KDF Reloaded behaviour. See docs/COMPAT_SWITCHES.md for the catalogue.
_version_note: Maintained for v0.1.0-alpha.1. As switches are added in later releases, this template is updated alongside them.
